name: marsdawn
description: Export Markdown to PDF, and open Markdown files in the MarsDawn app, with the marsdawn command-line tool.
long_description: Lets an agent turn a Markdown file into a paginated PDF, rendered like MarsDawn's preview, and open a Markdown file in the MarsDawn app for the user to review, by running the marsdawn command-line tool installed on this Mac. It needs marsdawn 0.5.0 or later: brew install redtear1115/tap/marsdawn. It reads and writes only inside the folders you allow below.

tools.name: export_markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Export a Markdown file to a paginated PDF with the marsdawn command-line tool.

tools.name: open_in_marsdawn
tools.description: Open a Markdown file in the MarsDawn app with the marsdawn command-line tool.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders the tools may read Markdown from and write PDFs into, for example your Documents folder. Until one is added, every call is refused. Nothing outside them is read or written; inside them, an existing PDF is replaced only when the agent passes force.

marsdawn_path.title: marsdawn path
marsdawn_path.description: Where the marsdawn command-line tool is. Leave empty to look in PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.
